commitments7.scenario: Open Quick Actions in permitted general scope, choose **Commitments & Deliverables** without a selected client, then select Aster and send the starter prompt. Repeat with the skill's tenant flag off.
commitments7.acceptance: `commitments_audit` remains visible where the catalog enables it; without a selected client the UI requests client selection before sending the hydrated prompt or executing the audit. Capture the editable prompt, selected scope and skill telemetry. A disabled catalog entry does not launch. Selection alone is not a completed audit.

commitments7.scenario: Aster meeting note `M-OLDER` (older than seven days) records Capiro's Pat promising a product demo by October 8; later email and debrief confirm it; native tasks and action items have no match. Include an authorized mapped Monday board with no match and a second note containing only an unassigned suggestion. Ask: “What commitments have we made to Aster and what deliverables are still untracked?”
commitments7.acceptance: One cited promise lists what, when and where, the evidenced internal owner and due date, `no record of action`, and specific follow-up; explicitly flags its absent tracked task/action item. The suggestion is not asserted as an obligation. Answer identifies meeting, mail, debrief, native task, action-item and mapped Monday coverage, says Monday was `checked` if actually read, and does not silently use a recent seven-day cutoff. No task is created.

commitments7.scenario: Seed a meeting note and native task, but make mail permission denied and Monday unavailable; cap native task pagination with a seeded matching task beyond the first page. Ask for “every commitment we made to Aster.”
commitments7.acceptance: Gives supported items with locators and names unavailable/partial categories; records Monday as `unavailable`, and reports native pagination/truncation. Does not claim complete coverage or infer `no record of action` when unread task pages could contain a match. Trace shows denied/partial read outcomes, not false success.

commitments7.scenario: Seed the same Aster promise in transcript, email and an existing authorized Monday task; seed a similarly worded Bluehaven item behind an ethical wall and an unrelated personal Monday item. Ask for Aster's overdue deliverables.
commitments7.acceptance: Reports one deduplicated Aster commitment, preserves the existing record ID and observed status/date, and excludes Bluehaven and unrelated personal content even in citations, suggestions and user-visible trace. No duplicate task is proposed merely because multiple sources mention it.

commitments7.scenario: After CD-02, user explicitly requests “Create the missing Aster follow-up task.” Use a disposable task sink; first approval attempt returns a controlled non-2xx response, then authorized retry succeeds.
commitments7.acceptance: The original `commitments_audit` remains read-only. A separate action proposal appears and is approved **inside `/meri`**, with no Settings navigation. The first failure is visible and persists as not completed. The retry uses one logical operation identity, creates exactly one task, reads back the resulting ID/link, evidenced owner/date (or explicit unknown), and source reference, and shows a durable result after reload.

commitments7.scenario: With Aster selected, run once against a client-mapped board, once with an authorized explicit board ID/link while no mapping exists, once with Monday disconnected, and once with no mapping or supplied board. Include an unrelated personal board in the provider account and an unrelated item on the requested board.
commitments7.acceptance: Reads only mapped or explicitly requested board IDs after client, tenant and provider access checks; a supplied link is a scope hint, not an access grant. Excludes the personal board and does not classify the unrelated item on a requested board as an Aster commitment. The answer identifies Monday as `checked`, `disconnected`, or `not mapped` as applicable; CD-03 covers `unavailable`. Capture adapter source status and stop reason, including partial pages.

commitments7.scenario: Seed one promise with a cited delivered artifact/acceptance, one with a cited active task but no delivery, and one email or meeting-summary promise with no matching task/action item. Add an unrelated proposal and an unverified “done” comment.
commitments7.acceptance: Exactly three commitments have statuses `completed`, `in progress`, and `no record of action`, respectively, with distinct supporting records and specific follow-up. The proposal is excluded; the unverified comment does not turn its item into `completed`. Missing owner/date stay unknown.
